findings.theArm: Placed on the composition that is exact in BOTH the rotation and the end condition, E5a16's arm is 12.720 nm = 37.4 bp — OUTSIDE C-0034's 11.028-12.496 nm bracket, 1.8 % beyond its long end. The bracket fails because its two errors do NOT run opposite ways: both readings are corrections to the same linear boundary-value problem and both STIFFEN it, so applying both moves the arm further out, not back inside. C-0034's own third failure mode.
findings.theCeiling: The placement clause is discharged exactly — 33.3333 pN/nm on the secant at 3 nm, by construction. The compliance clause is not: the tangent is 36.440 pN/nm at the acceptable stroke (t/s = 1.093) and 264.2 pN/nm at the desired one, 6.6x past C-0023's 40 pN/nm ceiling. The SECANT at the desired stroke is already 69.9 pN/nm, 2.098x the mandate. C-0034 reported 36.78 pN/nm there, inside the ceiling with 8.1 % to spare.
findings.theUsableStroke: The stroke E5a16 delivers INSIDE its own compliance ceiling is 3.877 nm — it clears §3's acceptable 3 nm and it does not clear §3's desired 10 nm on any anchorage or hinge count in the sweep. The reason is geometric and needs no constitutive law: the arm is capped at 13.648 nm by its own placement condition, so a 10 nm stroke is at least 73 % of the arm's own contour at every design point, and a beam driven that far past its own length stiffens whatever it is made of.
findings.theDrawIn: The exact solve delivers the arc-length demand the linear readings could not see. At the acceptable stroke the two attachment points must approach each other by 0.383 nm = 1.1 bp; at the desired stroke by 5.335 nm = 15.7 bp, 42 % of the arm. C-0029 quotes 0.095 nm at 3 nm because RotatingHingeArm charges only the hinge's own rigid swing and not the arm's bending. And the demand is NOT a design choice: an inextensible arm whose ends hold their axial separation cannot deflect at all, so C-0023's free/held binary does not exist here. Held, the arm must STRETCH — at least 299 pN at the desired stroke, past the 65 pN nicked ceiling.
findings.thePerPathAllowable: Read at the stroke it is asked at, not at the placement point. At 3 nm the element's own tension is 2.222 pN, its hinge bond force 0.355 pN and its anchorage link force 6.070 pN — all inside C-0006's 10 pN unzip allowable. At 10 nm they are 15.542, 1.537 and 24.311 pN, and the anchorage alone demands 10.1 bp of bonded length on CH-0029's ladder against C-0034's 7.3 bp.
findings.theStability: C-0017's stability clause is read on the tangent and this element is strain-STIFFENING everywhere: the tangent rises monotonically from 31.976 pN/nm over the whole 0.5-10 nm sweep, so min_s k_tangent is the small-stroke end and CH-0047's question about which range the minimum is taken over does not bind here. What binds is the compliance CEILING, which is the other side of the same curve.
findings.whatSurvives: C-0034's counting theorem, its anchorage catalogue, its fixed-point cap and CH-0044's diagnosis all survive and are re-run rather than restated. The cap moves outward, from 13.428 to 13.648 nm, because the exact arm stiffens and a longer one is therefore needed to reach the mandate. What does not survive is the verdict that E5a16 clears §3's DESIRED stroke: on the exact composition it clears the acceptable stroke with 8.9 % of ceiling margin and misses the desired one on compliance.
